description: South African forwarder, FCL export to Rotterdam (ZAR quote).

input.subject: Rates please: 2 x 20ft Durban to Rotterdam
input.body:
Good day,

Please send rates for 2 x 20ft dry containers Durban to Rotterdam, port to port, FCA Durban. Cargo is canned fruit, about 21 t per box.

Kind regards,
Thandiwe Mokoena
Karoo Citrus Exporters
